import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'adelie': 'Adelie', 'gentoo': 'Gentoo'})
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'})
    # Convert text numbers to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['bill_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['bill_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['bill_depth_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['bill_depth_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix negative flipper values (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    # Group by species and sum body mass
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return grouped.to_dict()
